original.statement: The implementation of toFQDNs selectors in policies has been overhauled to label IPs with matching selectors instead of creating separate cidr identities, requiring automatic state migration and potentially causing temporary packet drops during upgrade/downgrade unless upgrading from v1.15.6 or newer.

change.after: "IPs observed in DNS lookups are now labeled with the selectors `toFQDNs` matching them"

corrected.statement: The toFQDNs selector implementation in policies changed: instead of creating cidr identities for each allowed IP, IPs observed in DNS lookups are now labeled with the toFQDNs selectors matching them. Cilium migrates its internal state for toFQDNs policy entries automatically on upgrade or downgrade.

decision.reason: [ev-25984c3785d4] says the toFQDNs selector implementation was overhauled: "Instead of creating `cidr` identities for each allowed IP, IPs observed in DNS lookups are now labeled with the selectors `toFQDNs` matching them". Cilium migrates its internal state automatically, so the subject and the behavior-changed type are right. The proposed "before" value paraphrases the text, though, so I'm correcting both before and after to the evidence's literal wording.
